en: Reduce ad hoc type assertions across TypeBox tool compilation, MCP schema adapters, Session tool detection, and built-in memory tools while keeping unavoidable erasure casts at named internal boundaries.
zh-CN: 减少 TypeBox 工具编译、MCP schema 适配、Session 工具识别与内置 Memory 工具中的临时类型强转，并将不可避免的类型擦除断言收口到命名的内部边界。
